title: OpenRouter: Routing-Felder im Request, Antwort ohne Anbieter- und Quantisierungsfeld, Feld provider_name von GET /api/v1/generation
source: OpenRouter Provider Routing Doku, Schnappschuss 22.10.2026 (quellen/literatur/D_regulatorik_kontext/OpenRouter_Provider_Routing_Doku.html, SHA-256 cb5c428d715ba7c5d13a4332c7fe5d0205b82a6e88d346adbcd52085772700de); OpenRouter-API-Referenz, Schnappschüsse 25.10.2026: Überblick (https://openrouter.ai/docs/api/reference/overview.md, SHA-256 ec662db8fd2c37854ef928bf66312317d19715178be8171c7b7f6d717538312b) und Get a generation (https://openrouter.ai/docs/api/api-reference/generations/get-generation.md, SHA-256 960dd905be65286c83681a10b92e9c4d71034c89e6f29f3f5799edbbb5014256); Aufzeichnungen tests/fixtures/api/ (ANK-94)
quote: order string[] - List of provider slugs to try in order […] allow_fallbacks boolean true Whether to allow backup providers when the primary is unavailable. […] quantizations string[] - List of quantization levels to filter by
quote_location: Provider Routing Doku, Feldtabelle des provider-Objekts (Textspiegel Zeilen 448–456)

further_quotes.quote: type Response = { id: string; […] choices: (NonStreamingChoice | StreamingChoice | NonChatChoice)[]; created: number; // Unix timestamp model: string; object: 'chat.completion' | 'chat.completion.chunk'; system_fingerprint?: string; // Only present if the provider supports it […] usage?: ResponseUsage; };
further_quotes.location: API-Referenz Überblick, Abschnitt Responses, „CompletionsResponse format“ (Textspiegel Zeilen 279–297): kein Feld für Anbieter oder Quantisierung

further_quotes.quote: You can also use the returned `id` to query for the generation stats (including token counts and cost) after the request is complete via the `/api/v1/generation` endpoint.
further_quotes.location: API-Referenz Überblick, Abschnitt „Querying cost and stats“ (Textspiegel Zeile 433)
